01 Antidepressants · class card

Other antidepressants

atypical antidepressants · bupropion · mirtazapine · trazodone

Practice
  1. 23-year-old woman with depression asks for an antidepressant binges and vomits several times a week; wants to quit smoking worried about weight gain on other drugs potassium 3.1 mEq/L · chloride 92 mEq/L → Bupropion → bupropion is contraindicated in bulimia and anorexia because it lowers the seizure threshold and purging disturbs electrolytes; SSRIs remain first-line antidepressants
  2. 38-year-old man with a painful erection lasting 6 hours began a sedating antidepressant at bedtime 2 weeks ago no sickle cell disease; no injected erectile drugs BP 118/76 mm Hg · HR 88/min → Trazodone → trazodone blocks alpha-1 receptors and can cause priapism; bupropion causes insomnia and no sexual dysfunction, and mirtazapine sedates and raises appetite without sexual dysfunction
  3. 78-year-old woman with depression, poor sleep and weight loss starts mirtazapine at bedtime no seizures, eating disorder or heart disease weight 48 kg, down 4 kg · BP 128/74 mm Hg → Increased appetite and weight gain → mirtazapine blocks histamine H1 receptors, so it sedates and raises appetite and weight, welcome here; insomnia belongs to bupropion, and mirtazapine causes no sexual dysfunction
